## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)  
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)  
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)  
- [ ] Documentation update  
- [ ] Chore: cleanup/renaming, etc.

## Checklist
- [ ] One topic per PR, with tests for new behaviour and bug fixes
- [ ] User-visible flow changed: e2e suite run and `e2e/tests/` updated
- [ ] Route changed: OpenAPI documents and `packages/expo-api-types` regenerated
- [ ] Schema or sqlc change: new numbered migration (up + down), `internal/db/generated/` regenerated
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/code-map.md`, `docs/bridge-protocol.md`, new fixtures in `docs/test-data.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, game assets or other people's blueprints committed
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
